normalization.average: Percentile clipping [0.1, 99.9], linear scale to [0, 255] uint8
normalization.correlation: Percentile clipping [1.0, 99.0], linear scale to [0, 255] uint8

methods.stitching: Multi-field groups at the same (animal, session, scan, depth) are composited into a single image using motor coordinates (field_x_um, field_y_um) and physical FOV dimensions (um_width, um_height). Fields are placed at their relative positions in a canvas sized to the bounding box of all fields. Pixel resolution is determined by the first field in the group (um_width / px_width). Non-covered regions are filled with the minimum value of the image.
methods.thumbnails: Three resolutions per image: 64px (short edge, WebP q=50), 256px (short edge, WebP q=50), and full resolution (WebP q=85). Aspect ratio is preserved. Resampling uses Lanczos filter. File paths derived from node_id: thumbs/{node_id}_{avg|corr}_{64|256|full}.webp
